# Assumption of Moses Chapter 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Corrupt Rulers of the Last Days

---

**1** But after the punishment, in the time of their ruin, there will arise among them men who are deceitful in peaceful times.

**2** They will be self-promoting hypocrites in everything they do, lovers of extravagant banquets at every hour of the day, gluttons and revelers.

**3** They will gorge themselves on what belongs to the poor and afflicted.

**4** They will say: we have set royal tables.

**5** Their hands and minds will be occupied with impure things, and their mouths will be full of boasting.

**6** They will even say: do not touch me, lest you pollute the high position I hold.

**7** And they will be dishonest, hating and denouncing one another.

**8** They will love luxury, take bribes, and practice no justice.

**9** They will devour the homes of widows and gentle people, saying: we are righteous.

**10** But they will actually destroy the land, plundering the wealth of honest people through wickedness and deceit.

**11** They will have no more understanding than ordinary people, and yet they will be praised as learned men.

**12** They will be swollen with pride and will say: I am a lord sitting on a throne, and my glory comes before everyone else.
